user.title: Grant Aerona3 Heat Pump (ASHP)
user.description: Enter your Grant Aerona3 heat pump's connection details. All entities will be created with 'ashp_' prefixes for better organisation.

data_description.host: The IP address of your Grant Aerona3 heat pump
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read data from the heat pump (recommended: 30 seconds)

features.title: System hardware
features.description: Tick the parts your heating system actually has. Only matching entities will be created and polled — you can change this later via Configure.

data_description.has_dhw_tank: Domestic hot water cylinder heated by the heat pump
data_description.has_ehs: External heat source for space heating (terminals 41-42)
data_description.has_cooling: System is configured to provide cooling as well as heating
data_description.zones: Choose 'dual' if you have a second (slave) heating zone

error.cannot_connect:
Failed to connect to the heat pump. Please check:
• IP address is correct
• Heat pump is connected to network
• Modbus TCP is enabled
• Port 502 is accessible

abort.already_configured: This heat pump is already configured. Each heat pump can only be added once.

init.title: ASHP Integration Options
init.description: Adjust polling and tick the parts your heating system actually has. Changing hardware options reloads the integration and adds/removes the matching entities.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the heat pump for data updates (5-3600 seconds)
data_description.flow_rate_lpm: Water flow rate through the system for COP calculations (1-100 L/min)
